fresh_queue_setup: Offline exclusive single-bar initialization only for genuinely new work; consult TEAM.md and named handover. Resume saved queues in place.
controller_recovery: Committed WAL streaming refill, discovery prefers empty slots, recorded recovery and no-launch guard
solver_recovery: Bounded same-task polling retries; sanitized HTTP diagnostics
detail_recovery: Isolate individually failed requests only with successful sibling and healthy verified form; retain exact-ID allowance
closure_audit: Verified absences count as progress; isolated roster-only lookup mode preserves ordinary queries
browser_slots: Configurable 1..4 live children including discovery; retains all four durable worker queues and records policy changes. Two-bar performance remains experimental.
discovery_yield_guard: Pause after 900 active seconds without new identities or verified roster checks once known detail work is drained; pending queries remain saved; pause persists across ordinary resumes and requires recorded operator recovery.
modern_transport: Redesigned JSON directory; fixed and incremental pagination; durable detail jobs; one same-document transient retry within original deadline; no blind challenge retries

live_validation.scope: Isolated diagnostic, not national coverage or guaranteed future access

phase_policy: Reuse verified browser until work drains or existing phase/runtime limit; no artificial 30-search/240-detail restart; persistent stops unchanged
